models.name: coco-yolov8n
models.purpose: Generic object detection plus CSRT tracking assistance. This model has no drone class.

models.name: drone-yolov8n
models.source: Locally trained YOLOv8 detector from licensed drone datasets
models.purpose: Drone-specific visual confirmation model for PC-side vision_bridge inference.

notes: ONNX, PT, PKL, image datasets, and training runs are local assets and must not be committed.
Copy this file to models/MODEL_MANIFEST.json after export and fill the real hashes locally.
COCO yolov8n is not a drone detector. Use the drone-yolov8n entry only after training with licensed drone data.
